title: Auritus/Apricity: fresh full export, keep frozen in legacy, plan Prospectus sign-in
description:
PLATFORM DECISIONS (thread "Platform decisions", 2026-10-17; source report /mnt/project-files/platform-decisions.md).

AURITUS/APRICITY: both still in legacy; no board item tracks moving/retiring them; an Auritus board comment says keep own auth (conflicts with Prospectus). Recommendation: fresh full export of both to local disk, keep frozen in legacy, move Auritus sign-in to Prospectus when hear.aurit.us launches. Apricity depends on Auritus GPUs.

Source: Claude Code Projects handoff, 2026-10-19.
right_now_summary: Auritus and Apricity will be exported, kept frozen in legacy, and moved to Prospectus sign-in later.
